answer: Escrowed bond plus a public referral vine. Each newcomer locks 60 coins for 20 epochs and names a sponsor, hanging on the vine. Peers may dispute a suspect; five jurors review it, and a confirmed fake loses its bond and its sponsor is slashed. 1,000 fakes cost 60,000 coins against a 30,000 monthly pool, so forgery loses even at the zenith. As the tide of fakes rises, honest agents pay once and keep full rewards; only a clean vine collects.
